adjudications.finding: The refuter alleged that the Remarks sentence attributing to Sierpinski a ZF theorem for an everywhere-sequentially-continuous function R -> R was false.
adjudications.decision: The current text is correct and is deliberately distinguished from the pointwise theorem proved on this item. Herrlich, Axiom of Choice (2006), Theorem 4.52 in the cited edition, proves in ZF that every globally sequentially continuous f:R->R is continuous; the following result treats the non-ZF pointwise assertion. Current specialist discussions independently state the same global/pointwise distinction. The refuter conflated those quantifier patterns. No mathematical, citation, or source edit is licensed.

evidence.cited_source: H. Herrlich, Axiom of Choice, Lecture Notes in Mathematics 1876, Springer, 2006
